answer: Each head must redeem one sealed batch of pigment from a rationing issuer and publish that lot's composition signature to the epoch beacon, so a farm reusing a single lot across many addresses shows up as a duplicate at settlement. Clones cannot copy a lot they never bought, and the issuer's haven keeps a public ledger of every release, one per address. The scarce input is physical supply: unprintable, non-transferable between heads, so every extra head needs another issuer willing to part with another batch.
